# Vendored front-end assets

Served by the web app under `/static/vendor/`, so the pages work without internet access.

| Asset | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three-0.160.0/build/three.module.js`, `three-0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js` | three.js 0.160.0 (r160), the version the page used from jsDelivr | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/` | MIT, `three-0.160.0/LICENSE` |
| `schibsted-grotesk/*.woff2`, `font.css` | Schibsted Grotesk v7 (variable, weights 400-700, latin + latin-ext) | Google Fonts | SIL OFL 1.1, `schibsted-grotesk/OFL.txt` |
